title: MCP tool discovery, approval and test-call experience

counters.meaning: tools a model may call right now

risks.label: Write
risks.because: nothing said otherwise: the fail-closed default

denials.speaks: the tool is outside the allowlist
the server never returned that tool
the harness policy needs a human approval

checks.check: the hub's tab strip has a fourth tab — Tools — with a count of what it holds
checks.detail: tabs: Catalog, Connected, Tools, Activity

checks.check: the Tools panel is a labelled tabpanel with a summary, filters, a list and a real empty state
checks.detail: summary in a live region, a labelled filter group, one list and one empty state

checks.check: switching to Tools is a real tab change: one panel shown, the roving tab stop moved
checks.detail: switchMcpTab() whitelists tools exactly like the other three

checks.check: the tab and its count are rendered from the same state the rows are
checks.detail: renderMcpHub() calls renderMcpTools(), which sets the tab count from the rows

checks.check: configured, discovered, available and denied are four numbers, each named
checks.detail: configured: servers the operator added · discovered: tools the servers actually returned · available: tools a model may call right now · denied: tools the allowlist refuses

checks.check: a server with no tools yet is counted separately, not hidden among the zeros
checks.detail: `N configured without tools yet` appears only when a server has returned nothing

checks.check: an empty Tools tab names the next action instead of showing a blank panel
checks.detail: the empty state says what to do, not that there is nothing

checks.check: the filter chips count what they would show, and one is pressed
checks.detail: All / Read-only / Writes / Denied, each with a live count and aria-pressed

checks.check: search reaches the tool list, and a search with no hit says so and offers to clear itself
checks.detail: the hub's one search box narrows the rows, and the empty state clears it

checks.check: a tool is read-only only when the server says so, and a silent tool is a write
checks.detail: read → destructive → write_idempotent → write, with `write` as the fall-through

checks.check: the four risks have labels and a consequence in words
checks.detail: Read-only because the server set annotations.readOnlyHint · Write because nothing said otherwise: the fail-closed default · Write · repeatable because it carries an idempotency key · Destructive because the server set annotations.destructiveHint

checks.check: each row states the risk, the state, what a call does, what happens when a model asks, and its arguments
checks.detail: five labelled statements per row; the row carries its risk and state as data attributes too

checks.check: the row answers the policy question in the policy's own terms
checks.detail: one sentence per policy, plus one for a denied tool

checks.check: the approval policy is explained in words, per server policy
checks.detail: three sentences, one per policy, and the Connected row prints one for each server

checks.check: a denied row is drawn as denied and its test call is disabled
checks.detail: dashed row, Denied pill, no Test call

checks.check: Allow and Deny on a row are the allowlist itself, not a decoration
checks.detail: the row calls the same endpoint the drawer's checkbox does

checks.check: Test call opens that exact tool in the playground, on the server that owns it
checks.detail: openMcpToolTest() selects the tab, the server and the tool, then pre-fills its arguments

checks.check: the arguments are validated against the tool's own schema before anything is posted
checks.detail: invalid JSON, a non-object and a missing required argument each get a sentence

checks.check: the refusal is announced, and the button stays disabled while it stands
checks.detail: role=alert, cleared as soon as the arguments could be accepted; the button follows

checks.check: the risk is stated before the call, in the same words as the Tools tab
checks.detail: a pill and a sentence, plus the reason it will be refused when there already is one

checks.check: anything that is not a read needs a consent that names the tool and cannot be pre-ticked
checks.detail: hidden for a read, named for a write, and cleared whenever the subject changes

checks.check: the request carries confirm_write only because the box was ticked
checks.detail: confirm_write is added to the body only when the consent is given

checks.check: a 428 is drawn as a refusal that says nothing ran, not as a result
checks.detail: the confirmation_required body becomes its own state with the next step

checks.check: a 403 is drawn as a denial, with the kind named and the way out given
checks.detail: server_denied → the server is switched off · tool_denied → the tool is outside the allowlist · unknown_tool → the server never returned that tool · stdio_gate → the local-command gate is closed · approval_required → the harness policy needs a human approval · paused_idempotency → an earlier write is unresolved

checks.check: the inspector states the outcome, the cost and what authorized the call
checks.detail: outcome · latency · characters · grant source · policy · confirmation · whether a model would be asked

checks.check: long output is truncated with a count, and Show all restores every character
checks.detail: head and tail with the hidden count in between; Show all prints the rest

checks.check: the raw response is offered behind a disclosure that starts closed
checks.detail: `Raw response`, shut; the inspector fills it and opens nothing

checks.check: the server classifies a tool from its annotations, and a silent tool is a write
checks.detail: read → destructive → write_idempotent → write, in the same order as the page

checks.check: every tool the API returns states its own risk and whether it is allowed
checks.detail: get_mcp_server() adds read_only, destructive, requires_approval_override, risk and denied per tool

checks.check: a refusal is named before the call is even risked
checks.detail: disabled server, unknown tool, allowlisted-out tool, closed stdio gate — in that order

checks.check: the executor's own refusals can be classified without matching words on the page
checks.detail: server_denied · tool_denied · unknown_tool · stdio_gate · approval_required · paused_idempotency — and a fallback word for anything unrecognised

checks.check: the call route answers each refusal with its own status and a structured body
checks.detail: 404 unknown server · 403 with denial.kind · 428 confirmation_required · 409 duplicate side effect

checks.check: a call that runs says what authorized it, instead of implying it
checks.detail: surface, policy, grant source, approval, confirmation, risk and whether a model would be asked

checks.check: the confirmation is required before the executor, not after it
checks.detail: the 428 is returned before any execution is attempted

checks.check: the six MCP routes are still there
checks.detail: /api/mcp/servers · /api/mcp/servers · /api/mcp/import-json · /api/mcp/servers/{alias} · /api/mcp/servers/{alias}/sync · /api/mcp/servers/{alias}/call

checks.check: the stdio launch gate is untouched
checks.detail: a local command still needs the operator's own opt-in, whatever the page says

checks.check: the auto approval policy still means what it meant
checks.detail: auto runs without asking unless the tool asks for an override; this story did not tighten it

checks.check: action admission and the workspace panes are still in place
checks.detail: the admission gate the harness goes through, and all six panes

checks.check: no React rewrite and no new dependency
checks.detail: the frontend is still the same single document

checks.check: every control the old playground had is still on the page
checks.detail: mcpPlayServer, mcpPlayTool, mcpPlayArgs, mcpPlayBtn, mcpPlayOutput, configuredMcpServersList, mcpToolsCountBadge, activeMcpPills, mcpImportJsonInput, mcpSaveBtn

checks.check: a browser walk drives the tool browser and the test call on a screen
checks.detail: mcp_tools_walk.mjs: 57 recorded checks

checks.check: the walk proves a write cannot be posted without consent, and the server refuses it if it is
checks.detail: the page's gate and the server's 428 are both asserted

checks.check: the walk proves Deny is the allowlist and that Allow recovers the same call
checks.detail: Deny → 403 tool_denied on the server → Allow → the same call succeeds

checks.check: the walk covers every state the ledger asks for, and can photograph the old dialog
checks.detail: empty · list · filters · search · confirm · error · loading · result · long · denied · recovery · failure · keyboard

checks.check: captures exist for every state, viewport and theme
checks.detail: 120 after PNG · missing: none

checks.check: the before set is the same instrument against the dialog this story replaced
checks.detail: 112 before PNG across 8 viewport/theme runs
